annotations.title: Chance of a sale within two years (by suburb)

description:
Modelled chance that a home in a suburb or city block sells within the next two years, as a percentage, for every block and suburb in Australia we score. **Modelled estimates.**

Coverage: About 262,000 mesh blocks and 12,100 suburbs across every state and territory; blocks we did not score return no data. Current to 2026-05-22. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/sale-probability`.

One call returns every mesh block in the suburb.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.
